channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: Benson Boone, Ben Stiller, and a banana: Decoding 2026’s most tech-coded Super Bowl ad
item.description: Instacart’s ad campaign feels engineered for the internet.

item.title: Rampant violence, do-nothing security: Church-run housing complex ignores cries for help
item.description: Residents of the Thomas Paine Square Apartments in the Fillmore say their landlord and building management are negligent.

item.title: New report confirms that San Francisco is expensive — but San Jose is worse
item.description: The Cost of Living Index shows that SF was the sixth most expensive area in the U.S. last year.

item.title: Super Bowl fever is about to sweep through the Bay. Most 49ers fans are already sick
item.description: A rival has the chance to hoist the Lombardi Trophy at Levi’s Stadium. It’s a scene plenty of Bay Area residents want to avoid.

item.title: Buster Posey talks Giants’ Harrison Bader addition, rotation, and payroll flexibility
item.description: The president of baseball operations indicated team ownership is willing to push past MLB’s luxury tax threshold when considering more upgrades.

item.title: Businesses close, students walk out as SF joins national ICE protest and strike
item.description: “We’re not willing to stay silent,” said a protester in response to the fatal shootings in Minneapolis.

item.title: ‘Section 415’ podcast: Analyzing the 49ers’ offseason agenda
item.description: Kyle Shanahan must upgrade the wide receiver unit, the defensive line, and several other holes on the roster to keep a Super Bowl window open.

item.title: On day of general strike, incidents on BART, Muni disrupt transit
item.description: A medical emergency closed the West Oakland BART station, while a gas leak halted Muni light-rail service along the T-Third line.

item.title: Bay Area pizza chain faces eviction from Stonestown Galleria
item.description: Blondie’s Pizza allegedly owes more than $74,000 in back rent.

item.title: Bay Area cycling community rallies after Alex Pretti’s death
item.description: Rides in San Francisco and Oakland are part of a global tribute to the nurse killed in Minneapolis by federal authorities.
